content:
1.  "Every day feels like an uphill battle."
2.  "I feel like I’m drowning in my own thoughts."
3.  "I can’t seem to shake these feelings of sadness."
4.  "I have trouble sleeping nearly every night."
5.  "I constantly feel like something bad is going to happen."
6.  "My mind does not stop racing, especially at night."
7.  "I have lost interest in things I used to enjoy."
8.  "I can barely get out of bed most days."
9.  "I feel so alone, even when I'm around people."
10. "I'm constantly worried about everything."
11. "I'm always feeling on the edge."
12. "I often get shortness of breath and chest discomfort."
13. "I'm always feeling tired even though I haven't done much."
14. "I’ve lost my appetite."
15. "I prefer to be alone rather than being with my friends."
16. "I lost my job and I don't know what to do next."
17. "I feel detached from the world sometimes."
18. "I feel like the world is closing in on me."
19. "I have extreme fear of certain things or situations."
20. "I'm afraid I might hurt myself."
21. "Sometime, I think the world would be better without me."
22. "I don’t feel like I’m good enough for anyone or anything."
23. "I'm always feeling irritable and agitated."
24. "I feel worthless."
25. "I blame myself for everything."
26. "I struggle to concentrate on anything."
27. "I feel like my future is hopeless."
28. "It's hard for me to make decisions."
29. "I cry for no reason."
30. "Every little thing overwhelms me."
31. "I feel numb."
32. "I have nightmares constantly."
33. "I have terrible mood swings."
34. "I fear being judged by people."
35. "I feel disconnected from my own body."
36. "I keep forgetting things."
37. "I’m always very tense and on guard."
38. "I always second guess my decisions."
39. "I'm always pessimistic."
40. "I can't control my worry."
41. "I avoid going places because of my anxiety."
42. "Even little things make me extremely angry."
43. "I feel heavy all the time, like a weight is on me."
44. "I worry about dying or being seriously ill."
45. "I feel like I am in constant danger."
46. "I'm always thinking negatively about myself."
47. "I keep obsessing over specific things.”
48. "I have so many fears and they seem irrational.”
49. "I worry about humiliating myself.”
50. "People tell me I worry too much, but I can't help it.”
51. "I don’t feel real...like I’m watching myself from a distance.”
52. "I feel like I'm being constantly judged.”
53. "Hallucinations scare me, they seem so real.”
54. "I keep looking for reassurance.”
55. "I always feel out of control.”
56. "I fear I might panic in public.”
57. "I'm always restless and can't sit still.”
58. "I'm haunted by the traumatic events in my past.”
59. "I fear small spaces and becoming trapped.”
60. "I end up relying on alcohol to cope with my feelings.”
61. "I overthink every situation.”
62. "Everyday activities exhaust me.”
63. "My relationships are suffering because of my mental state.”
64. "I fear that I will lose control and go crazy.”
65. "I avoid situations that might trigger my anxiety.”
66. "I obsess about perfection.”
67. "I have thoughts of ending my life.”
68. "I have trouble leaving my house.”
69. "I'm always on high alert, waiting for something to go wrong.”
70. "My panic attacks take over me.”
71. "I have unwanted intrusive thoughts.”
72. "My past failures eat me alive.”
73. "I dread meeting new people.”
74. "I shy away from taking on responsibilities.”
75. "I constantly fear losing those I love.”
76. "I often feel a sense of impending doom.”
77. "I feel as if I'm going to pass out in social situations.”
78. "Every little ache or symptom I have makes me fear I have a serious illness.”
79. "I have trouble standing up for myself.”
80. "I keep obsessing over my past mistakes.”
81. "I get easily startled.”
82. "My heart races for no reason.”
83. "My fears interfere with my daily life.”
84. "I can't seem to quiet my mind.”
85. "I spend hours a day on repetitive behaviors.”
86. "I avoid things or situations because they give me anxiety.”
87. "I'm always afraid of making mistakes.”
88. "I can't stop the panic once it starts.”
89. "I feel paralyzed by fear.”
90. "I'm always worried about my health.”
91. "I get irritated when my routine gets disturbed.”
92. "I fear being in crowded places.”
93. "I can't relax.”
94. "I fear being away from my safe place or person.”
95. "I'm always feeling hypersensitive to criticism.”
96. "I get embarrassed easily.”
97. "I have disturbing thoughts about harming myself or others.”
98. "I keep dwelling on negative events.”
99. "I can't stop these obsessive thoughts.”
100."I constantly question my sanity."
